website.note: skipped — company pivoted to crypto treasury Nov 2025; biotech subsidiary Gravitas info adequate from 10-K

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: In November 2025 the company strategically pivoted to a Canton Network / Canton Coin (CC) digital asset treasury company; biotech operations now exist only via subsidiary Gravitas Life Sciences. Lead asset GV104 (nalmefene buccal film) is past clinical-trial stage — pursuing 505(b)(2) NDA leveraging FDA's prior REVEX findings; no additional clinical trials required (rolling NDA submission planned H1 2027). GV023 (oral infliximab) is preclinical, in-licensed Sept 2024 from Intract. No active company-sponsored P1/P2/P3 clinical trials on ctgov.

excluded_preclinical.indication: Inflammatory bowel disease (oral TNF-alpha mAb infliximab)
excluded_preclinical.modality: Oral infliximab via Intract Soteria/Phloral platform

near_term_NDA.indication: Prophylactic protection against synthetic opioid exposure (military / first responders)
near_term_NDA.status: No further clinical trials required per March 2025 Type C meeting with FDA; rolling NDA submission planned H1 2027; FDA approval anticipated H1 2028
